neighbours.label: the word 'molecular' / 'molecule(s)' (any language)
fire: The lab uses molecular markers to identify the species.
Each sugar molecule contains six carbon atoms.
Advances in molecular genetics changed medicine.
Oxygen molecules bind to the iron in hemoglobin.
She won a prize for her work on molecular motors.
The drug's molecular target is a kinase.
Large molecules diffuse slowly through the gel.
His thesis covered molecular dynamics simulations.
quiet: The lab uses genetic markers to identify the species.
Each sugar crystal contains many carbon atoms.
Advances in clinical genetics changed medicine.
Oxygen atoms bind to the iron in hemoglobin.
She won a prize for her work on electric motors.
The drug's primary target is a kinase.
Large particles diffuse slowly through the gel.
His thesis covered fluid dynamics simulations.
